definitions.explanation: A hairstyle made by interweaving three strands of hair. Can also refer to braided cord or rope using the same three-strand technique.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三|み}つ{編|あ}みにした。
{三|み}つ{編|あ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧がいた。
examples.english: There was a girl with braids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三|み}つ{編|あ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だった。
examples.english: Having my mother braid my hair was one of my childhood pleasures.

notes:
Literally "three-strand weave" — {三|み}つ (three) + {編|あ}み (weaving/knitting). The most common type of braid in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to braid (hair)
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ほどく→ほどく：10504_hodoku⟧: to undo a braid
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おさげ→おさげ：20771_osage⟧: braided pigtails

RELATED HAIRSTYLE TERMS:
- ⟦おさげ→おさげ：20771_osage⟧: pigtails
- ⟦ポニーテール→ポニーテール：20944_poniiteeru⟧: ponytail
- お⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧: hair bun
- {編|あ}み{込|こ}み: French braid, cornrows

USAGE:
Most commonly refers to hair braiding. Can also apply to braided cord, rope, or leather. The technique of interweaving three strands is the same regardless of material.
